### Which file do I download?

| | |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | `Hofwerk-Setup-…-win-x64.exe` is the full installer and works without internet. `Hofwerk-WebSetup-…-win-x64.exe` is a small installer that downloads the app while it installs. |
| **Linux** | `Hofwerk-Setup-…-linux-x64.tar.gz` is the full installer. `Hofwerk-WebSetup-…-linux-x64.tar.gz` is the small one that downloads the app. |
| **Windows, if the app does not work** | When Hofwerk shows an error, **Try a different version** downloads a second version of Hofwerk (`Hofwerk-Compat-…`, about 13 MB) that is drawn another way. You do not need to download it yourself. |
| **Updates** | The `.hwpack` and `.sha256` files are what Hofwerk's own "Update now" downloads. You do not need them. |

Already have Hofwerk? Open **App settings** and press **Check for updates**.
The full history is in the [changelog](https://github.com/Kalmai221/Hofwerk/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
